title: Trump Tweet Undercuts Rally
text:
aapl
The market was doing a nice job of following through on Friday's sizable gains until about 2.40 pm ET when President Trump tweeted that he would announce his decision on the Iran Deal at 2pm tomorrow. The indices where at the highs when that news hit and reversed sharply.
This is not unexpected news and the likelihood is that he will kill the deal. Oil hit its highest level in years which is an indication that the market thinks the deal is dead.
Killing the Iran deal isn't a huge negative, but it was a catalyst that allowed the sell programs to act on the headlines. The indices were becoming a little extended and sentiment a bit frothy so it made sense to trap the bulls with a little sell program on a Trump tweet.
The Buffett induced euphoria in Apple ( AAPL ) cooled off with the stock closing near the lows of the day after some intraday chasing. A down day tomorrow would confirm a bearish candlestick pattern, but Apple is a place to park idle cash so it is likely to see some good support should it cool off.
The S&P500 briefly surpassed its 50-day simple moving average at 2679 but closed under it which is an indication that market players are looking for at least a pause in this rally at a logical level. The Buffett optimism gave the market some upside momentum but you have to wonder how long it can be sustained when it is more emotion than anything else.
There was some good action today in bigger cap momentum names that have been struggling and overall breadth was good but the last hour dip is an indication that the bulls' control of the market is not that strong. The reaction to the Iran tweet is an illustration that it won't take much bad news to trigger another round of selling.
